concern_summary: This concern covers user profile management relevant to the split confirmation page, allowing users to input or modify their personal and account information needed for confirmation.
This concern deals with error handling and the response for the split confirmation page, ensuring proper navigation and user feedback when encountering issues or non-existent pages.
The split confirmation page facilitates the user's journey through chat functionalities, allowing them to initiate chats, select participants, and confirm the chat configurations.

This concern focuses on managing personal user information and address details that may be required during the split confirmation, ensuring that relevant user details are accurately captured and submitted.
This concern revolves around managing the configuration and editing of policies within the split confirmation page, allowing users to interact with policy details and update them as necessary.
This concern is related to the money request confirmation process, validating participant details and ensuring all necessary fields are filled out before processing the transaction.
This concern addresses the pagination and step management within the split confirmation page, ensuring that users can navigate through different stages of the confirmation process efficiently.

This concern focuses on the interaction logic and pagination for displaying transactional information related to the split confirmation page, allowing users to navigate through various items and options relevant to their request.

This concern encompasses the overall management and validation of split bills and expenses among participants, including selecting participants, calculating split amounts, creating split transactions, and preparing reports related to the division of the total amounts.
